schema.name: runtime_job
schema.sql:
CREATE TABLE runtime_job(
  job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  request_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL,
  admission_sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
  created_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at_order_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version >= 1),
  initial_record_json BLOB
)

schema.name: runtime_job_admission_sequence_idx
schema.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX runtime_job_admission_sequence_idx ON runtime_job(admission_sequence)

schema.name: runtime_job_created_idx
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX runtime_job_created_idx ON runtime_job(created_at_order_key, job_id COLLATE BINARY)

schema.name: runtime_job_updated_idx
schema.sql: CREATE INDEX runtime_job_updated_idx ON runtime_job(updated_at_utc DESC, job_id)
